About

A bit about us

Two Face is an all-day cafe concept by By/Suka Collective, with locations in both Canggu and Ubud, Bali. It offers specialty coffee, hearty brunch dishes, and a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. In Canggu, Two Face has built a strong community around quality food and coffee, with a vibrant space that mixes comfort and creativity. The menu blends Western favorites with subtle Asian influences, served in a bright setting that feels lively yet approachable.

The Ubud location brings the same spirit to a more laid-back, nature-filled environment. Surrounded by greenery, it offers a calm but social space to enjoy coffee, brunch, or a casual catch-up with friends. Across both locations, Two Face reflects By/Suka Collective’s passion for creating spaces where good food, great coffee, and a sense of community come together naturally.
